eligible_team_methods.BRPHJ_NLP: NLP1 uses sentence embeddings/FAISS followed by BM25; NLP2 omits that reranking; NLP3 uses a retriever plus BERT reader.
eligible_team_methods.CSIROmed: PE reranks DFR results with sentence embeddings and a date filter. NIR combines neural similarities with BM25 over multiple fields and applies another date rule.
eligible_team_methods.CincyMedIR: Run1 searches query text against title/abstract with BM25. Runs2/3 search extracted concepts; run3 additionally uses question and narrative.
eligible_team_methods.DA_IICT: All uses three topic fields; narr uses narrative; narr_qe adds Bo1 expansion from ten documents. All use In_expC2.
eligible_team_methods.Elhuyar_NLP_team: Indri passage retrieval alone, ClinicalBERT passage reranking, and SBERT/Indri combination. Document scores come from passages; training sources differ.
eligible_team_methods.IRC: BM25 then topic-specific DRMM/GloVe reranking. Training material comes respectively from Entrez title/abstract results, PMC full text, and PubMed title/abstract results.
eligible_team_methods.IRIT_markers: All rerank title/abstract BM25+RM3 candidates with MS MARCO-trained BERT. Base omits exact-match marking; the two marked descriptions do not distinguish their variants.
eligible_team_methods.IRLabKU: Run1 reranks BM25 by publication year. Run3 additionally uses title/abstract/paragraph indexing and BioBERT paragraph/query similarities.
eligible_team_methods.IR_COVID19_CLE: Three Lucene abstract-search runs differ by DFR, information-based similarity, or Dirichlet language modeling; metadata says each returns the first100 documents.
eligible_team_methods.KAROTENE_SYNAPTIQ_UMBC: All index automatically extracted document tags in Elasticsearch; NARRATIVE, PROSE, and QUESTION vary the topic fields.
eligible_team_methods.KoreaUniversity_DMIS: Both combine DenSPI/covidAsk with Covidex document scores on a COVID-focused subset. Run1 uses question/SQuAD; run2 uses query/SQuAD+NaturalQuestions.
eligible_team_methods.SFDC: Both describe semantic retrieval using generated query-paragraph training pairs and Sentence-BERT; the descriptions do not identify their difference.
eligible_team_methods.SavantX: Three entries describe the same automatic SavantX PRO workflow and unsupervised relationship model; their specific differences are not documented.
eligible_team_methods.THUMSR: BERT and Conv_KNRM combine BM25 with neural scores using Reinfoselect training; Meta-Conv-KNRM uses meta-learning.
eligible_team_methods.TM_IR_HITZ: Two runs use400-topic LDA to form candidate subsets before BM25F; tm_lda400 ranks abstract-topic distributions by Jensen-Shannon divergence.
eligible_team_methods.TU_Vienna: Both rerank the first100 BM25 results using TKL trained on MS MARCO document data. Bases differ: GloVe versus BERT embeddings without attention layers.
eligible_team_methods.Technion: JPD reranks language-model candidates using passage features and INEX-trained RankSVM; MEDMM expands queries; RRF combines submitted component rankings at k60.
eligible_team_methods.UB_BW: All use Terrier PL2 with title/abstract indexing; variants use word2vec expansion, term-dependence modeling, or Bo1 pseudo-feedback expansion.
eligible_team_methods.UIowaS: Filtered corpus and query+narrative inputs; runs use DPH, BM25, and BM25 with query expansion respectively.
eligible_team_methods.abccaba: Both describe lowercase concatenated-text BM25. bm25_baseline additionally specifies shorter queries and correction of a previous bug; both remain separate submissions.
eligible_team_methods.covidex: BM25R2 uses Anserini BM25. T5R1/T5R3 add MS MARCO-trained T5-11B; their indexed paragraph representations differ in abstract inclusion.
eligible_team_methods.ielab: All use BM25 then pseudo-feedback; variants further change query-field composition or combine recency with relevance.
eligible_team_methods.ixa: Whoosh/BM25F over a COVID-focused passage index; the three entries vary narrative, query, or question input.
eligible_team_methods.sabir: SMART vector methods: JSON-only pseudo-feedback, merged metadata/JSON representation, or separately scored metadata/JSON combination.
eligible_team_methods.smith: BM25, query likelihood, and RM3 over available document text; RM3 settings are explicitly described.
eligible_team_methods.udel_fang: F2EXP variants change indexing and topic fields; run2 adds publication-year reranking, while run3 uses axiomatic expansion and combines two indexes.
eligible_team_methods.unipd.it: Elasticsearch title/abstract baseline and two pseudo-feedback variants using10 documents and10 versus20 expansion terms; the filter is not explained.
eligible_team_methods.unique_ptr: Query sequential dependence, embedding-derived n-gram weighting, and an RRF combination of five component runs.
eligible_team_methods.uogTr: pyTerrier DPH variants add term proximity or Bo1 expansion and use query+question versus query+question+narrative fields.

CSIROmed: PE filters to documents published after November2019.
NIR assigns zero scores to documents created before December31,2019.
PE reranks50 candidates; NIR uses different neural and lexical document fields.
CincyMedIR: Plain-text and concept indexes differ; topic-field choices also differ.
Elhuyar_NLP_team: Passage-based document scoring; ClinicalBERT training is synthesized from title/abstract pairs, whereas SBERT is trained on SNLI/MultiNLI.
IRC: Pseudo-labels are obtained from external PubMed/PMC retrieval, with other topics providing negative training examples; explicit automatic classification is retained.
IRIT_markers: First-stage candidate depth1000 is stated; title/abstract representation omits full-text indexing in the description.
IRLabKU: Top50 publication-year prioritization precedes further processing; paragraph and document representations differ.
IR_COVID19_CLE: The stated returned depth is100, exactly the proposed retained depth; actual30-topic coverage and unique100 rows require a later body check.
KoreaUniversity_DMIS: Titles/abstracts must contain COVID-19 synonyms, yielding an approximately3000-document subset.
Both use Covidex scores, so separate team names do not imply independent origins.
A100-QA-pair validation set was used for hyperparameters.
SFDC: Distinct run IDs and MD5s, but identical method descriptions; no mechanism difference is inferred.
SavantX: Distinct run IDs and MD5s, but identical high-level descriptions; implementation differences are unspecified.
TM_IR_HITZ: The two LDA+BM25F systems restrict the indexed subset using question/narrative topic similarity; metadata does not explain the2000/5000 name suffixes.
TU_Vienna: Only the first100 BM25 candidates are reranked; original run depth still needs checking.
UIowaS: Corpus requires at least one stated coronavirus/COVID string pattern; question text is excluded.
abccaba: The near-identical spellings are not deduplicated: both are official uniquely identified submissions.
covidex: T5R1 includes title+abstract+paragraph, while T5R3 describes title+paragraph.
ielab: Documents with title alone and neither abstract nor full text are excluded.
ixa: COVID-19 synonym filtering on title/abstract; abstract and full-text paragraph indexing.
sabir: Document access differs: one run uses JSON only; others combine metadata and JSON representations.
unipd.it: Filtering is stated but not specified.
unique_ptr: One submitted member is already a fusion of five runs; group membership is not a pure independent-model family.
